body.name: Honest confidence fiber
body.construction: If \(\mathcal C_{\alpha}\neq\varnothing\), set \(\widehat I_{T,\alpha}(P,\rho,b,o,e)=\operatorname{hull}(\bigcup_{P'\in\mathcal C_{\alpha}}I_T(P',\rho,b,o,e))\); if \(\mathcal C_{\alpha}=\varnothing\), set \(\widehat I_{T,\alpha}(P,\rho,b,o,e)=[0,1]\). The known zero pattern ensures that every \(e\) positive under \(\Pr_{P,\rho,b,o}\) is positive under each retained \(\Pr_{P',\rho,b,o}\).
